At Petkeljärvi, you feel like a part of nature as ancient pines hum, ponds shimmer, and your steps follow a ridge over 10,000 years old. The war history of Petkeljärvi and the border Karelian culture of the village of Möhkö also speak to you.

At Petkeljärvi, you feel like a part of nature as ancient pines hum, ponds shimmer, and your steps follow a ridge over 10,000 years old. The war history of Petkeljärvi and the border Karelian culture of the village of Möhkö also speak to you.
Ancient forests with their old-growth pines
Ridge trails bordered by wilderness lakes
Day hiking trails and connections to longer trekking routes
Outdoor centre, caravan area and camping area
Natural Features of Petkeljärvi National Park
The forested esker ridges and rugged lake scenery of Petkeljärvi National Park create a wilderness-like atmosphere. The soundscape is filled with the rustling and creaking of old-growth trees.
Visitor's checklist
The National Park is a nature reserve
Make campfires only in designated sites
Camp only at permitted camping sites
Remember to bring a trash bag
